content.title: Rory McIlroy Masters score, leaderboard updates for Round 3 recap
content.text: Updated April 11, 2026, 7:28 p.m. ETRory McIlroy has history in his sights at the 2026 Masters. His six-stroke lead over Sam Burns and Patrick Reed was a record at Augusta National for the largest lead through 36 holes. Now the 36-year-old from Northern Ireland and Jupiter, Florida resident is poised to become the fourth player ever to repeat as Masters champion and the first since Tiger Woods in 2001 and 2002.McIlroy has 15 birdies against just three bogeys across his 12-under start to the Masters, highlighted by his four straight birdies to close out Round 2. The five-time major champion holed out from 29 yards away on No. 17, bringing the Augusta crowd to a roar in what might go down as the shot of the tournament.The Palm Beach Post is following McIlroy's pursuit of history with his updating scorecard. Keep scrolling for the latest updates from McIlroy's Round 3.Watch the Masters live on Fubo (free trial) Masters leaderboard 2026T1. Cameron Young: -11 (F)T1. Rory McIlroy: -11 (F)3. Sam Burns: -10 (17)4. Shane Lowry: -9 (F)Keep up with all the latest scores on our live Masters leaderboard. Rory McIlroy score today at Masters 2026Rory McIlroy opened with a bogey on the first hole, and he narrowly missed an eagle putt on No. 3, settling for birdie. He also just missed a birdie putt on No. 5, then sent his tee shot on No. 6 sailing left and watched it roll among the patrons. McIlroy managed to save par and closed the front nine at even par.A birdie on the 10th put him at 1 under for Round 3 and 13 under for the tournament, but he followed with a shot into the water in front of the 11th green. McIlroy recorded a double-bogey 6 on the hole.McIlroy then bogeyed again on the 12th hole. His six-stroke lead to start the day has vanished through 12 holes, as McIlroy trails Cameron Young by one.But McIlroy bounced back on 14, a par-4 hole on which he found a rare fairway for this weekend. His second shot was a bit of a pull but it trickled toward the hole on the green, coming to a stop about 20 feet from the hole. But McIlroy converted the slippery putt for a birdie and a share of the lead.He added to his momentum on 15 by reaching the green on the par-5 in two. His putt for eagle looked really good most of the way, running out of steam at just the last moment. McIlroy's tap-in for birdie perched him back on top of the leaderboard, all alone, at 12 under, which is where he started the day. Rory McIlroy Masters Round 3 score, hole by holeHere's a look at McIlroy's hole-by-hole scorecard, along with his score to par for the round and tournament:Bogey 5 (+1 | -11)Par 5 (+1 | -11)Birdie 3 (E | -12)Par 3 (E | -12)Par 4 (E | -12)Par 3 (E | -12)Par 4 (E | -12)Par 5 (E | -12)Par 4 (E | -12)Birdie 3 (-1 | -13)Double-bogey 6 (+1 | -11)Bogey 4 (+2 | -10)Par 3 (+2 | -10)Birdie 3 (+1 | -11)Birdie 4 (E | -12)Par 3 (E | -12)Bogey 5 (+1 | -11)Par 4 (+1 | -11)Rory McIlroy Masters score 2026, round by roundRound 1: 67 (-5)Round 2: 65 (-7)Total: 132 (-12) When does Rory McIlroy tee off today?Rory McIlroy is in the final pairing with Sam Burns. McIlroy teed off at No. 1 at 2:50 p.m. ET. Has anyone won the Masters back to back?McIlroy is attempting to become just the fourth player ever to win consecutive green jackets. The other three to accomplish the feat are legends of golf:Jack Nicklaus: 1965 and 1966Nick Faldo: 1989 and 1990Tiger Woods: 2001 and 2002The fact that McIlroy won the 2025 Masters in a playoff would also fit into this trend. Nicklaus won the 1966 title in an 18-hole playoff, while both of Faldo's back-to-back wins came via a sudden-death playoff. How many majors does Rory McIlroy have?McIlroy has won five majors. Winning the green jacket last year gave McIlroy the career Grand Slam, meaning he has won all four major golf tournaments across his illustrious career. His first major title came in 2011 when he was just 21 years old, but he had to wait 11 years to finish off the career slam. Here's a look at McIlroy's majors:2011 U.S. Open (Congressional Country Club, Bethesda, Maryland)2012 PGA Championship (Kiawah Island Golf Resort Ocean Course, Kiawah Island, South Carolina)2014 PGA Championship (Valhalla Golf Club, Louisville, Kentucky)2014 Open Championship (Royal Liverpool Golf Club, Hoylake, England)2025 Masters (Augusta National Golf Club, Augusta, Georgia) Rory McIlroy Masters dinner menuBeing the reigning champion means McIlroy had the privilege of organizing the famous Masters Champions dinner the Tuesday before the tournament. Here's what he put on the menu:Appetizers: Peach & Ricotta Flatbread (balsamic, hot honey, basil); Rock Shrimp Tempura (creamy spicy sauce); Bacon-Wrapped Dates (goat cheese, almonds); Grilled Elk Sliders (caramelized onion jam, roasted garlic aioli)First course: Yellowfin Tuna Carpaccio (foie gras, toasted baguette, chives)Main course: Choice of Wagyu Filet Mignon or Seared Salmon (traditional Irish champ, sautéed Brussels sprouts, glazed carrots with brown butter, crispy Vidalia onion rings)Dessert: Sticky Toffee Pudding (vanilla ice cream and warm toffee sauce) What's the largest win at the Masters?If McIlroy can further extend his six-stroke lead, he'll be on pace to break the records Tiger Woods smashed in his historic 1997 Masters victory. A 21-year-old Woods set the Augusta record with a nine-stroke lead after 54 holes (with a score of 201) and ended up winning by 12 shots with what was then a record score of 270 (Dustin Johnson would break that mark with a 20-under 268 in 2020). Rory McIlroy score at Masters Round 2McIlroy shot a 7-under 65 in the second round Friday, the low score on the day and one stroke off the record for the lowest score ever in the second round at the Masters. He birdied the last four holes to take a six-shot lead into Saturday's Round 3. After a bogey on No. 3, the reigning champ was clean the rest of the day, going on birdie runs twice throughout the round. Here's a look at his hole-by-hole scorecard, along with his score to par for the round:Par 4 (E)Birdie 4 (-1)Bogey 5 (E)Par 3 (E)Par 4 (E)Par 3 (E)Par 4 (E)Birdie 4 (-1)Birdie 3 (-2)Par 4 (-2)Par 4 (-2)Par 3 (-2)Birdie 4 (-3)Bridie 3 (-4)Birdie 4 (-5)Par 3 (-5)Par 4 (-5)Par 4 (-5)Masters coverage 2026: How to watch on TV, live streamNoon-2 p.m.: Paramount+2-7 p.m.: CBSStreaming: ESPN app | Fubo (free trial) | Masters.com and the Masters appRounds 3 and 4 of the 2026 Masters will broadcast nationally on Paramount+, CBS' subscription streaming servce, starting at noon before switching to CBS at 2 p.m. The CBS broadcast is available to stream via Fubo, which offers a free trial for new subscribers, and the tournament is available to stream for free on Masters.com and the Masters app. Featured group and hole streaming from PGA Tour Live is available all day on the ESPN app (with a subscription to the Select plan) starting at 10:15 a.m.
